entries.test: Whether Zuckerberg's March 2023 'Year of Efficiency' statement named AI as Meta's single largest investment, and whether Meta's stated priorities shifted from the metaverse to AI by April 2023.
entries.note: The quoted Zuckerberg statement is public and can be checked directly.

entries.test: Reporting from early 2023 on whether Meta canceled its consumer AR glasses plans as a cost-cutting measure.
entries.note: Only the cancellation is firmly asserted. The idea that the savings went to AI is the author's stated assumption and can't be tested.

entries.test: Whether Meta abandoned metaverse investment once AI took off, judged by Reality Labs spending and Meta's stated plans in 2023.
entries.note: Rhetorical overstatement, but the plain reading is testable: Reality Labs spending went on through 2023.

entries.test: Whether Meta's copycat products (Snapchat, Clubhouse, Twitch and TikTok clones) failed to compete with the products they copied, based on usage and shutdown records.
entries.note: Instagram Stories and Reels are arguable counterexamples to 'failing to compete'.
